Draws from the posterior

Source: R/accessors.R
profile_draws.Rd

Draws the between-site standard deviation, the mean of the effects and the diagnostics from their posterior, and optionally the site effects.

Usage

profile_draws(x, ndraws = 4000, seed = NULL, sites = FALSE)

Arguments

x

An object of class reliability_posterior.

ndraws

Number of draws, a positive integer.

seed

Seed of the random number generator, an integer, or NULL (the default) for a seed from the clock. The seed used is stored in the attribute seed. The state of the session's generator is restored afterwards, so set.seed() before the call does not make the draws reproducible; give seed instead.

sites

If TRUE, the draws include the site effects.

Value

A data frame with one row per draw and the columns draw, sigma_tau, effect_mean (or one column per coefficient of the mean model), I, mean, H, J_eff and, with sites = TRUE, one column per site, named effect_ followed by the site's label (effect_A for site A).

Details

sigma_tau is drawn by inverting a table of its distribution function, then the mean of the effects from its normal distribution given sigma_tau, and the site effects from their normal distributions given both (Lee, 2026, Appendix D.3). The draws are independent. They are for plots and for summaries that the package does not compute; the summaries of the package itself come from the integrals and have no Monte Carlo error.

References

Lee, J. (2026). The geometry of informativeness: A Bregman-centroid diagnostic for partial pooling in multisite trials. Unpublished manuscript.

Examples

fit <- reliability_posterior(estimate, se = se, data = eight_schools)
draws <- profile_draws(fit, ndraws = 1000, seed = 1)
mean(draws$I)
#> [1] 0.2258355
